name: Instalar Salud Mental V6

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

concurrency:
  group: cepoes-instalar-salud-mental-v6
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  instalar:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          ref: main
          fetch-depth: 0

      - uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'

      - name: Instalar pipeline Salud Mental V3
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import base64
          import hashlib

          files = {
              'actualizar_salud_mental.py': (
                  """""",
                  "c276c876c3d82da3a89462ea8465ccc52819b10bcd3edf947e544fbde6832b24",
              ),
              'verificar_salud_mental.py': (
                  """""",
                  "29068c66d100adb3f420d67e30097c932fc97cb9e42499439b5d94fa0d7d02d8",
              ),
          }

          for path, (payload_b64, expected_sha) in files.items():
              payload = base64.b64decode(payload_b64)
              actual_sha = hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()
              if actual_sha != expected_sha:
                  raise SystemExit(
                      f"Hash inválido {path}: {actual_sha} != {expected_sha}"
                  )
              target = Path(path)
              target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
              target.write_bytes(payload)
              print(f"✓ {path} · {len(payload)} bytes · {actual_sha}")
          PY

      - name: Validar instalación
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python -m py_compile actualizar_salud_mental.py verificar_salud_mental.py
          grep -n "cepoes-salud-mental-v3" actualizar_salud_mental.py verificar_salud_mental.py
          grep -n "SNIC_PAIS_URL" actualizar_salud_mental.py
          grep -n "EXPECTED_CABA_2025 = 236" actualizar_salud_mental.py
          grep -n "EXPECTED_JURISDICTIONS = 24" actualizar_salud_mental.py
          grep -n "0800-999-0091" actualizar_salud_mental.py
          grep -n "PANEL_SEPARADO_NO_PUBLICADO" actualizar_salud_mental.py
          git diff --check

      - name: Mostrar diff
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git diff -- actualizar_salud_mental.py verificar_salud_mental.py

      - name: Commit
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git config user.name "cepoes-bot"
          git config user.email "actions@users.noreply.github.com"

          git add actualizar_salud_mental.py verificar_salud_mental.py

          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "Sin cambios: Salud Mental V6 ya está instalada."
          else
            git commit -m "feat: instalar pipeline V3 de salud mental"
            git push origin HEAD:main
          fi

      - name: Confirmar
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          echo "✓ Salud Mental V6 instalada en main"
          echo "✓ El workflow existente .github/workflows/salud-mental.yml se conserva sin cambios"
          echo "Siguiente workflow: Actualizar salud mental"
